title: Functional Quality Program Manager
description:
**The group you’ll be a part of**
---------------------------------

The Global Operations Group brings information systems, facilities, supply chain, logistics, and high-volume manufacturing together to drive the engine of our global business operations. We help Lam deliver industry-leading solutions with speed and efficiency, while actively supporting the resilient and profitable growth of Lam's business.

**The impact you’ll make**
--------------------------

As a Functional Quality Program Manager at Lam, you are not just overseeing projects – you’re orchestrating breakthroughs in support of supply chain quality. You’ll lead cross-functional teams through successful project execution, blending your technical excellence with strategic planning to drive systemic part quality improvement across the entire supply chain. Your role is vital, owning technical projects from initiation through delivery using your expertise in planning, directing, and monitoring schedules and budget. In this role, you will directly contribute to engaging with supplier engineers to resolve complex quality issues the lead to overall Lam product quality improvement and cost savings in manufacturing and in install/warranty expenses as a final result.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* + Provide the primary interface between the field and factory to enable efficient quality resolution for supplier quality problems.
  + Take ownership and accountability for the success of resolving these quality issues within the expected performance metrics and delivery meets business requirements on time and within budget.
  + Partner with stakeholders to understand process and system requirements and deliver enhancements based on a changing technology landscape.
  + Lead Continuous Improvement projects, owning the entire lifecycle from inception to impactful results.
  + Perform data collection and statistical analysis, and report results to inform program schedules and deliverables.
  + Coach and train supplier engineers in 8D process methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  + Influence cross-functional stakeholders to continuously improve the process and inspire alignment.
  + Deliver change management for programs that are sustainable and maintains long-term success.
  + Successfully navigate multiple projects in a highly matrixed and dynamic environment.
  + Leverage AI where applicable to drive efficiency gains within the business process and system.

**Who we’re looking for**
-------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 12+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 8+ years’ experience; or a PhD with 5+ years’ experience; or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of continuous improvement or technical program management.
* Expert level in structured problem solving (8D) with clear abilities to utilize problem solving tools in highly technical quality problems to reach acceptable outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and demonstrating excellent leadership and influence skills to deliver results.
* Demonstrated understanding of program management methodologies, tools, and systems
* Strong supplier management and methodologies to drive systematic quality performance improvement
* Ability to perform in depth data analysis required to visually represent, influence, and resolve complex business processes, systems, and quality problems
* Excellent performer in a highly matrixed environment with competing priorities and schedules
* Demonstrated leadership for cross-functional teams to successful achievement of objectives
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills with the ability to present to audiences at all levels in the Company.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Preferred qualifications**

  + Experience in or deep knowledge of Semiconductor fabrication, Semiconductor Equipment Operations, or related industries is a plus.
  + Expert knowledge in business process and system development, alignment, and implementation for a large organization
  + Expert knowledge of Program Management methods and experience in Product Development & Release (PDR) procedures.
  + Relevant project management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, Scrum Master, or PRINCE2.
  + Experience in Lean Six Sigma methodology or certification (Green Belt, Black Belt) is a plus.
  + Experience with Agile and/or Waterfall project methodologies.
  + Expertise with project management software and tools including MS Project, QuickBase, Office Timeline, or equivalent.
  + Experience in Change Management methodologies is a plus.

**Our commitment**
------------------

We believe it is important for every person to feel valued, included, and empowered to achieve their full potential. By bringing unique individuals and viewpoints together, we achieve extraordinary results.

Lam Research ("Lam" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. Lam is committed to and reaffirms support of equal opportunity in employment and non-discrimination in employment policies, practices and procedures on the basis of race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, or military and veteran status or any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. It is the Company's intention to comply with all applicable laws and regulations. Company policy prohibits unlawful discrimination against applicants or employees.

*Lam offers a variety of work location models based on the needs of each role. Our hybrid roles combine the benefits of on-site collaboration with colleagues and the flexibility to work remotely and fall into two categories – On-site Flex and Virtual Flex. ‘On-site Flex’ you’ll work 3+ days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, with the opportunity to work remotely for the balance of the week. ‘Virtual Flex’ you’ll work 1-2 days per week on-site at a Lam or customer/supplier location, and remotely the rest of the time.*

title: Technology Program Manager
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description
  
Program Manager, Product DevelopmentRole Summary
  
Drives end-to-end program execution across the Enterprise Lease Abstraction Platform's product development initiatives, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring delivery stays aligned with the platform roadmap set by the Platform Manager. Combines strong program execution skills with working business analysis capability, able to define scope directly and step into detailing of scope activities when dedicated BA support isn't available or bandwidth is constrained. Operates with an ownership mindset — focused on getting the initiative delivered, not on strict role boundaries.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Understand business objectives and independently define/scope the work required to deliver an initiative, including boundaries, assumptions, and out-of-scope items
  
Translate the platform strategic roadmap into an executable program plan with milestones and sequencing
  
Coordinate delivery across engineering, BA, architecture, and QA teams to keep initiatives on track
  
Identify, track, and manage cross-team dependencies and critical-path risks
  
**Run program governance:** status reporting, steering committee updates, RAID logs
  
Manage scope, schedule, and resourcing trade-offs; escalate conflicts to the Platform Manager
  
Step into a details role when needed — gathering requirements, documenting processes, running requirements workshops — to keep an initiative moving when dedicated BA capacity isn't available
  
Own release planning and coordinate go-live readiness across teams
  
Facilitate sprint/PI-level ceremonies (planning, reviews, retros) where relevant
  
Manage vendor or third-party delivery partners contributing to the program
  
Maintain a single source of truth for program status, risks, and decisions
  
Support post-implementation reviews and capture lessons learned
  
Pick up gaps that fall between roles rather than waiting for them to be formally assigned — if something is blocking delivery and no one else owns it, take it on or actively find who should
  
Key Skills / Attributes
  
Strong scoping discipline — able to size work without waiting on a formal requirements document
  
**Working BA capability:** requirements elicitation, process mapping, user story writing
  
Comfortable operating as both “program lead” and “hands-on analyst” depending on what the initiative needs
  
Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination
  
**Ownership attitude:** treats “that's not my job” as unacceptable when delivery is at stake — proactively fills gaps, flags issues even outside direct responsibility, and drives outcomes rather than deflecting to process or role definitions
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

====================

**Mandatory**

**Frontend, Dashboarding & Visualization**

* **Strong modern frontend development** using React, Angular, Vue or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience building **dashboards, analytics applications and reporting interfaces** using real-world data.
* Experience with **interactive data visualization**, including charts, trends, KPIs, alerts and time-series views.
* Working knowledge of at least one visualization/dashboarding technology such as **ECharts, Plotly, D3.js, Grafana, Kibana or equivalent**.

**Backend & APIs**

* **Strong backend/API development** using Node.js, Python, Java or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with **REST APIs, JSON, authentication, authorization and service integration**.
* Understanding of **service-oriented/microservices architecture** and scalable API design.
* Understanding of **event-driven and asynchronous processing** concepts.

**Data**

* **Working knowledge of SQL and data modelling**.
* Practical familiarity with **NoSQL and/or time-series databases**.
* Experience handling **large, dynamic or time-series data**, including querying, aggregation and transformation.

**Cloud, DevOps & Production**

* **Hands-on Docker/containerization and CI/CD** experience.
* Understanding of **cloud deployment, scalability, performance and production troubleshooting**.
* Practical familiarity with **application observability**, including logs, metrics and monitoring.
* Ability to use **dashboards, logs and monitoring data to troubleshoot production issues**.

**Security & multi-tenancy**

* **Secure coding and API security** fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, input validation and secrets management.
* Understanding of **multi-tenant application concepts**, including tenant-aware access and data isolation.

**Preferred**

* Experience with **ThingsBoard or similar IoT/telemetry platforms**.
* Experience with **Grafana, Kibana, ELK/Elastic Stack, Loki, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Tempo, Dynatrace, AppDynamics, CloudWatch or equivalent**.
* Experience integrating applications with **log aggregation, monitoring, APM and distributed tracing platforms**.
* Familiarity with **Kafka, MQTT or equivalent messaging/event platforms**.
* Experience with **time-series databases** such as TimescaleDB, InfluxDB or equivalent.
* Experience with **data lakes and high-volume telemetry platforms**.
* Familiarity with **RAG, LLM APIs and Agentic AI**.
* Experience with **Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures**.
* Domain exposure to **Energy, Industrial Power or OT systems**.

**Qualifications**
==================

**Mandatory**

* **4+ years of professional full-stack development experience** building and deploying production applications.
* **Strong hands-on capability across frontend, backend and database layers**, with the ability to work independently across the stack.
* Demonstrated experience building **data-driven dashboards, visualization, analytics or reporting applications**.
* Experience developing **production-grade, scalable and secure applications**.
* Practical experience with **cloud environments, Docker and CI/CD**.
* Strong **production troubleshooting and problem-solving capability**, including the ability to diagnose issues across application, API, data and infrastructure layers.
* Ability to work in a **fast-moving MVP environment**, prototype quickly and incorporate customer/pilot feedback.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills for working with **ML/AI, data, OT and platform engineering teams**.

**Preferred**

* Experience building products for **telemetry, IoT, analytics, monitoring or operational use cases**.
* Experience integrating with **observability and monitoring ecosystems**, rather than only implementing application-level logging.
* Experience with **multi-tenant SaaS platforms** at production scale.
* Experience with **event-driven/distributed systems** and high-volume data applications.
* Experience integrating **AI/ML model outputs or GenAI capabilities** into production applications.
* **Energy, Industrial Power or OT domain experience** is an advantage, but **not mandatory**.

description:

Our global Pack is made up of people who thrive on solving hard problems, moving fast, and building technology that protects organizations around the world. We’re looking for a **Program Manager** to be part of making this happen.

  

**Position Overview and Objective**

The Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.

  

The Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high-quality security solutions on time and within budget.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Strategic Influence & Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high-impact initiatives.
* Executive & Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.

* Lead and manage large-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.

* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.

* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI & Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
Drive data-driven insights by leveraging AI-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive-level decision-making with real-time program intelligence.  

  

**Experience & Requirements**
-----------------------------

* 8-10 years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large-scale software deployments
* 8-10 years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 6 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem-solving experience with large-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi-disciplinary teams.
Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.  

  

**Nice to Have**

* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.

title: Project Co-ordinator
description:
CAX builds large-scale immersive and interactive environments — multi-zone experience centers,museums, interactive installations, real-time 3D and enterprise AI platforms. A single project caninvolve a dozen stakeholders (end client, main contractor, AV integrator, content studios, hardwarevendors) and dozens of stations across multiple floors.  
We are looking for a Project Coordinator to hold that detail together: tracking scope station by station,chasing open queries to closure, keeping documentation current, and being the reliable pair of handson site during installation and commissioning.  
This is a coordination role, not a design or engineering role — but you will be surrounded by AV,software and 3D people, and you are expected to become fluent enough in their language to beuseful.  
**What you’ll do**  
**Project tracking and documentation**

* Maintain the master project tracker: scope per zone/station, deliverables, owners, dates andcurrent status.
* Run the RFI / open-query log — raise, chase, escalate and close items with the client and vendorteams.
* Keep the decision log and version-controlled documentation (scope sheets, BOMs, hardwarelists, cable schedules, sign-off records).
* Prepare weekly status reports, MOMs and dashboards for internal review and client circulation.

**Stakeholder and vendor coordination**

* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for client-side PMs, main contractors, AV integrators andcontent partners.
* Schedule and run coordination calls; publish minutes with clear owners and due dates.
* Track vendor deliverables, POs, deliveries and dependencies; flag slippage early.

**On-site support**

* Travel to project sites for surveys, installation, integration, snagging and go-live.
* Coordinate site readiness — power, network, mounting, access, permits, manpower.
* Maintain a live snag list through commissioning; drive it to zero before handover.
* Support UAT, client walkthroughs and handover documentation.

**Operations**

* Support resource planning and site rosters across concurrent projects.
* Track project spend against budget; process vendor invoices and travel/logistics.
* Maintain asset and hardware inventory across sites.

**Must-have skills**

* 2–4 years in project coordination or project management, ideally in AV, systems integration,events, experience design, interiors/fit-out or software delivery.
* Strong written English — you will be writing client-facing minutes, RFIs and status reports daily.
* Ruthless follow-up discipline.The core skill is knowing what is open, who owns it, and when it isdue, without being reminded.
* Comfortable with project tooling: Excel/Google Sheets (pivot tables, trackers), and at least oneof Jira / Notion / ClickUp / Asana / MS Project.
* Willing and able to travel — domestic frequently, international occasionally (valid passportpreferred).
* Site-comfortable: able to work in an active construction or fit-out environment duringinstallation phases.

**Technical literacy (required baseline)**

You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be the person on site who can describe a problemaccurately instead of saying “it’s not working.”

* **Operating systems:** comfortable on both Windows and macOS — knows they behavedifferently, and knows which applications and file formats live on which. Able to install software,check display settings, read Device Manager or System Information, and find logs when asked.
* **Devices and connectivity:** confident setting up and troubleshooting iPads and Android tablets— WiFi profiles, guided access/kiosk mode, MDM basics, pairing to a network or a controller, andwhy a device on guest WiFi can’t reach a machine on the project VLAN.
* **Networking fundamentals:** understands IP addresses, subnets, static vs DHCP, VLANs,switches and ports, and can run ping / ipconfig / ifconfig to isolate whether an issue isnetwork, device or application.
* **AV signal basics:** knows HDMI vs DisplayPort vs USB-C, extenders, matrix switchers, and cantrace a signal path from source to display to identify where it breaks.
* **Cabling and labelling:** understands Cat6 runs, patch panels, port mapping, and why a cleanlabelling scheme saves a week during commissioning.

**Good to have**

* Hands-on experience with AV systems: projectors, media players (BrightSign or similar), touchtables, audio DSP, projection alignment.
* Exposure to software or real-time 3D delivery (Unity, Unreal Engine, web apps) and to howbuilds, versions and releases work.
* Familiarity with construction/fit-out coordination — drawings, mockups, snag lists, handoverpacks.
* Documentation habits: Obsidian, Confluence, SharePoint or similar.
* Basic understanding of Gantt, critical path and dependency planning.
* Experience working with GCC clients or on projects in UAE/Saudi.

**Who this suits**

Someone organised to the point of being slightly annoying about it. Someone who notices that astation hasn’t had a decision confirmed in three weeks and raises it before anyone asks. Someonewho is happy to be in the office chasing documentation on Tuesday and on a museum floor at 11pmon Friday making sure a display comes up correctly.

**What we offer**

* Direct exposure to some of the most ambitious experiential projects in the region.
* A small, senior team — you will learn AV, software and delivery from people doing it hands-on.
* Clear growth path toward Project Manager.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager I, Project Management
description:
Job Description:

**1. Portfolio and product-development leadership**
---------------------------------------------------

* Own the project roadmap from use-case selection and requirements of definition through engineering, prototyping, field trials, validation, documentation and release.
* Lead the development of standardized solution packages for applications such as rice hullers, oil expellers, flour mills, sugarcane crushers and other agricultural or food-processing machines.
* Define system requirements covering the solar array, power electronics, motor/drive, machine load, protection, controls, energy storage where applicable, installation conditions and expected duty cycle.
* Coordinate design reviews and ensure that technical decisions, assumptions, risks and changes are documented and traceable.
* Maintain a prioritized pipeline based on customer need, technical feasibility, livelihood impact, affordability, replicability and market potential.

**2. Testing, validation and quality**
--------------------------------------

* Establish test and validation plans with clear acceptance criteria for safety, functionality, energy performance, reliability, environmental conditions and application-specific output.
* Coordinate laboratory testing, OEM testing and controlled field pilots; analyse results, lead corrective actions and approve readiness for deployment.
* Create and maintain standard technical documentation, including architecture, bill of materials, sizing tools, installation instructions, commissioning checklists, operating guidance, maintenance requirements and troubleshooting procedures.
* Ensure applicable regulatory, electrical-safety, machinery-safety, quality and country-specific requirements are identified and addressed with relevant internal experts and external test partners.
* Build a structured lessons-learned process so field feedback is translated into design improvements and updated standards.

**3. Partner and stakeholder management**
-----------------------------------------

* Lead collaboration with machine OEMs, solar and electrical partners, test laboratories, installers, channel partners and field organizations.
* Align cross-functional internal stakeholders across engineering, offer management, quality, supply chain, commercial, sustainability and country teams.
* Define partner work packages, deliverables, technical interfaces, governance, review cadence and escalation routes.
* Communicate complex technical and commercial topics clearly to senior leaders, partners and field teams across cultures and geographies.

**4. Market readiness and deployment**
--------------------------------------

* Work with commercial and country teams to define target customer segments, value propositions, route-to-market, pricing logic, partner enablement and launch plans.
* Collaborate with financing institutions and ecosystem partners to develop practical financing models for end users and entrepreneurs, including suitable repayment and risk-sharing approaches.
* Plan pilots and early deployments, including partner selection, site readiness, training, commissioning, service support, data capture and user feedback.
* Develop training and sales-enablement materials that make solution selection, sizing, installation, operation and maintenance simple for partners and field teams.

**5. Project governance and performance**
-----------------------------------------

* Prepare and manage the project plan, budget, resources, milestones, dependencies, risk register and decision log.
* Establish measurable indicators for technical performance, cost, quality, pilot outcomes, market readiness, partner capability and livelihood impact.
* Provide concise, evidence-based progress reports and recommendations to governance stakeholders; escalate critical risks early and drive closure.
* Manage multiple solution workstreams while maintaining rigorous scope, schedule, quality and change control.

**Expected outcomes**
=====================

* A prioritised portfolio and multi-year roadmap for solar-powered livelihood solutions.
* Validated, documented and release-ready solution packages for selected applications.
* Repeatable test protocols, sizing methods, installation standards and quality gates.
* Qualified OEM and ecosystem partnerships with clear roles and deliverables.
* Successful pilots that generate documented technical, commercial and user evidence.
* Market-entry and financing approaches adapted for priority countries in Asia and Africa.

(External) English Qualifications:

**Essential**
-------------

* Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical, electronics, power, renewable energy, mechanical or related engineering. An MBA or postgraduate qualification in rural management, product management or project management is an advantage.
* At least 10 years of relevant experience, including substantial responsibility for new-product development, system engineering, industrialization, technical project delivery or deployment of energy solutions.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional projects from concept through validation and launch or deployment.
* Working knowledge of solar PV systems, motors and drives, electrical distribution and protection, or productive-use equipment.
* Experience working with OEMs, suppliers, test partners and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong project controls, risk management, structured problem solving, documentation and stakeholder-management capability.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical audiences.
* Willingness to travel to partner, test and deployment locations in Asia and Africa.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience with off-grid or weak-grid solar applications, rural productive use of energy, agricultural machinery or distributed-energy solutions.
* Experience designing test plans, conducting field validation, leading root-cause analysis and managing product-quality improvements.
* Exposure to certification, conformity assessment and applicable electrical or machinery standards in emerging markets.
* Experience developing business models, customer finance, pay-as-you-go, leasing or asset-finance solutions for productive assets.

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

**The Role**  
***As a*** ***Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
* Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
* Review, Tracking & monitoring Schedule & Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays & areas of concerns.
* Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring & controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports.
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.

**About You**  
To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 12+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills.
* Extensive experience in Oil & Gas, energy sector & Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction.
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution-oriented delivery.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Project Planning & Control Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Project Operations Manager

**Your Role and Responsibilities**

In this role, you will Lead planning, scheduling, and cost control efforts for all project phases of individual delivery for small to large size projects in coordination with the project manager. Each day, you will manage and analyze actual and forecasted schedules, costs, revenues, and cash flow. You will demonstrate your skill by diligently monitoring, reporting, and managing deviations.

**Work Model:** #LI-Onsite

This role plays a key part in supporting Automation within the Energy Industries, helping deliver efficient, reliable, and digitally enabled project execution that enhances productivity and sustainability for our customers.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Overseeing project execution and performance, ensuring accurate schedule, cost, cash flow, and risk planning for individual projects.
* Analyzing project requirements to ensure that all essential activities are identified in sufficient detail to support realistic project schedules.
* Developing and maintaining properly linked, resource-loaded schedules with time-phased baseline, actual, and forecast data.
* Monitoring project progress and regularly analyzing the critical path to ensure that key activities and milestones are on track.
* Identifying, escalating, and providing solutions for schedule and cost deviations proactively.
* Preparing and presenting comprehensive project performance reports and metrics to support management decision-making.
* Supporting the Project Operations Manager in improving tools and processes.

**Qualification for the role**

* B.E./B.Tech in Electrical or Electronics Engineering from a reputed university with 6–8 years of experience in Project Management, Planning, and Project Controls.
* Proven expertise in planning and executing large-scale Electrical, Instrumentation, Automation, or Telecommunication projects, including management of small to medium-sized project portfolios.
* Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6, MS Project, Planisware, and Microsoft Office Suite for project scheduling, critical path analysis, resource optimization, and forecasting.
* Strong experience with SAP or equivalent ERP systems for cost tracking, budget monitoring, project costing, financial reporting, and forecasting.
* Hands-on expertise in Power BI, Power Apps, SharePoint, and reporting tools to develop dashboards, analytics, visualizations, and project performance metrics.
* Good understanding of Energy Industries and industrial production processes, with knowledge of electrical, instrumentation, automation, and telecommunication project requirements.
* Familiarity with the full project lifecycle, from planning and execution through commissioning, handover, and operational readiness.
* Strong communication, leadership, stakeholder management, analytical problem-solving, change management, conflict resolution, and time management skills, with a focus on delivery, quality, and continuous improvement.

**More About us:**

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Product Program Manager RAD and Change Management
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Lead Product Program Management for RAD subsystem products X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators for mobile and fixed radiography systems. Drive Engineering design changes and Product Life Cycle Management for X-Ray Tubes and X-Ray Generators at GEBEL.
  
Own installed-base product performance and drive improvements in quality, reliability, regulatory compliance, lifecycle, cost and delivery, while leveraging installed-base data to establish reliability targets and Design for Reliability for new product introductions.  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own field and factory performance of RAD Tubes and Generators, with focus on quality, reliability, compliance, cost and delivery.
* Monitor field performance and Early Life Failure (ELF) trends using FoA, IPFR90 and IPFR180 metrics and represent product performance in global reviews.
* Analyze field and reliability data using statistical methods, including Weibull analysis and B10/B50 life estimation, to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Lead customer complaint and field failure investigations, including field-return autopsy, failure analysis, RCA, corrective actions and product fixes.
* Partner with System Engineering, Field Engineering and Service teams for technical troubleshooting, product training and resolution of field issues.
* Support NPIs with reliability target setting, leveraging installed-base performance, failure trends and reliability insights.
* Support Risk Management activities, including DFMEA/PFMEA, design reviews, Verification & Validation and risk assessments.
* Maintain Technical Files, Risk Management and Design Control documentation, ensuring QMS compliance and audit readiness.
* Lead product lifecycle initiatives covering obsolescence, product improvements, regulatory compliance and Variable Cost Productivity (VCP).
* Chair Engineering Change Control Board (ECCB) reviews and drive timely, technically rigorous and QMS-compliant engineering changes for X-Ray Tubes and Generators.
* Serve as Engineering BPOC for Supplier Change Requests (SCRs), including initial impact assessment, cross-functional coordination and assignment of change owners.
* Represent Engineering during QMS, regulatory, certification and customer audits, and support Quality Management Reviews.
* Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Service, Supplier Quality and Sourcing to improve product quality, manufacturing yield, reliability and cost.
* Apply statistical methodologies to drive structured problem solving, RCA and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s / Master’s / Phd in Electrical and Electronics/Mechanical Engineering discipline.
* 8+ years of engineering experience, preferably in medical devices, medical imaging, X-Ray products or other highly regulated industries.
* Experience in Installed Base Engineering, Engineering Change Management, Design Controls, Risk Management and Product Lifecycle Management.
* Strong experience in field performance monitoring, failure analysis, RCA, reliability engineering and statistical data analysis.
* Working knowledge of Weibull analysis, B10/B50 life estimation, reliability target setting and Design for Reliability .
* Working knowledge of medical-device and X-Ray Tube/Generator product safety standards, QMS requirements and regulatory compliance, including applicable IEC 60601, ISO 13485 and ISO 14971 requirements.
* Working knowledge of QMS and Design Control tools, including DFMEA/PFMEA, Risk Management, Design Reviews, Verification & Validation, ECR/ECO, CAPA and configuration/change management.
* Experience with Supplier Change Management, obsolescence, product quality improvement and manufacturing/yield improvement.
* Familiarity with structured problem-solving tools such as 5-Why, Fishbone, Pareto analysis and statistical analysis.
* Six Sigma Green Belt certification preferred.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Strong technical leadership, systems thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* Ability to translate field and reliability data into product improvements and NPI reliability targets.
* Strong analytical, statistical and risk-based decision-making capability.
* Ability to influence and collaborate effectively across global cross-functional teams.
* Strong execution focus across quality, reliability, compliance, cost and delivery.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and technical documentation skills.
* Self-driven and results-oriented, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and execution excellence.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Project Manager - Data Platform Transformation
description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
**Position Summary**

Thermo Fisher Scientific is undertaking a strategic Data Platform Transformation within MSD Services to modernize its data architecture and enable scalable digital services, analytics and future AI capabilities.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the planning and delivery of the implementation and migration program. The role will coordinate cross-functional teams across MSD Services and Corporate IT/Enterprise Data Platform teams to ensure the transformation is delivered to agreed scope, schedule, budget and quality.

The role requires strong technology transformation and migration experience, with sufficient knowledge of cloud and modern data platforms to effectively manage technical teams, risks and dependencies.

**Key Responsibilities & Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

**Project Planning & Governance**
---------------------------------

* Own the integrated implementation and migration plan, including milestones, dependencies, resources and critical path.
* Establish project governance, RACI, delivery cadence and executive reporting.
* Maintain RAID, decision and change-control processes.
* Track delivery against scope, schedule, budget and agreed outcomes.
* Manage resource and capacity requirements across participating teams.

**Implementation & Migration Delivery**
---------------------------------------

* Coordinate readiness of the Data Platform for production workloads.
* Lead planning and execution of D2i (device telemetry) and BI/data warehouse migrations.
* Establish migration waves, priorities, entry/exit criteria and delivery milestones.
* Coordinate activities across Prepare, Design, Plan, Migrate, Go Live and Aftercare.
* Manage testing, data reconciliation, UAT, defect resolution and production readiness.
* Own integrated cutover planning, migration runbooks and go/no-go governance.
* Coordinate legacy decommissioning following successful migration.

**Stakeholder & Dependency Management**
---------------------------------------

* Act as the central coordination point across MSD Services, EDP/Corporate IT and technical teams.
* Manage cross-team dependencies, decisions, risks and escalations.
* Facilitate planning sessions, delivery reviews and steering meetings.
* Provide clear and concise status reporting to senior leadership.
* Ensure business continuity and stakeholder requirements are considered throughout migration.

**Operational Transition**
--------------------------

* Ensure operational readiness is incorporated into migration planning.
* Coordinate documentation, runbooks and knowledge transfer.
* Manage handover to the long-term Run & Maintain / DevOps organization.
* Ensure appropriate support and monitoring arrangements are established before go-live.

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

**Essential**
-------------

* 8+ years project/program management experience delivering complex enterprise technology transformations.
* Demonstrated experience leading data, cloud, data warehouse or application migration programs.
* Strong project planning, critical-path, dependency and risk-management skills.
* Experience managing multi-workstream programs with distributed/onshore-offshore delivery teams.
* Strong financial, resource and delivery management capability.
* Proven experience managing testing, production cutover and operational transition.
* Strong stakeholder management across business, engineering and enterprise IT organizations.
* Ability to drive accountability and delivery across teams without direct organizational authority.

**Technical Knowledge**
-----------------------

Sufficient technical knowledge to effectively manage and challenge engineering teams, preferably covering:

* Modern data platforms / Lakehouse architecture.
* Databricks and AWS or comparable technologies.
* Data lakes, data warehouses and ETL/ELT.
* Data migration, testing and reconciliation.
* CI/CD and DevOps.
* Data governance, security and data quality.

Technical architecture or engineering expertise is not required; the role is accountable for successful program delivery.

**Key Measures of Success**
---------------------------

* Delivery against agreed scope, schedule and budget.
* Successful migration of D2i and BI workloads.
* Predictable milestones, resource requirements and financial forecasts.
* Effective management of cross-team dependencies and risks.
* Production cutovers with minimal business/customer disruption.
* Successful operational handover and knowledge transfer.
* Controlled retirement of legacy capabilities following migration.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project-management certification preferred.
* Agile / SAFe experience desirable.
* Previous experience delivering a major data-platform or cloud transformation within a large global organization strongly preferred.

title: Project Manager
description:
**\*\*URGENT REQUIREMENT\*\***

A Civil Project Manager is a professional responsible for overseeing and managing construction projects in the civil engineering sector. This role involves coordinating all aspects of a construction project, from planning and design through to execution and completion. The primary duties of a Civil Project Manager include:

* **Project Planning**: Developing detailed plans and timelines, budgeting, and resource allocation for construction projects. This also involves assessing risks and ensuring all necessary permits and legal requirements are met.
* **Team Coordination**: Managing and supervising teams of engineers, contractors, laborers, and other staff. Ensuring clear communication and resolving conflicts or issues within the team is crucial.
* **Budget and Cost Control**: Overseeing the project’s financial aspects, ensuring that the project stays within budget. This involves estimating costs, managing expenses, and addressing any financial discrepancies.
* **Quality Control and Safety**: Ensuring that all work meets industry standards and safety regulations. The Civil Project Manager ensures quality inspections are done regularly and that safety protocols are followed to minimize risks on\-site.
* **Client Communication**: Acting as the main point of contact between the client and the construction team. The Civil Project Manager provides regular updates on the progress of the project and addresses any concerns or changes the client might have.
* **Scheduling and Deadlines**: Developing a timeline for the project and making sure milestones and deadlines are met. They often use project management software to track progress.
* **Problem Solving and Risk Management**: Handling any unexpected issues or challenges that arise during the project, such as delays, design changes, or material shortages, while managing the associated risks.
* **Documentation and Reporting**: Keeping detailed records of the project's progress, budgets, and any changes or incidents that occur. This documentation may be required for legal reasons or project review.

To succeed as a Civil Project Manager, strong leadership, problem\-solving, and communication skills are essential, along with a deep understanding of construction processes and civil engineering principles.

title: Program Manager , STEP
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a resourceful program manager who thrives on turning complex, cross\-functional challenges into clear plans and measurable outcomes?  

We are looking for a Program Manager who will be responsible for managing STEP program (Tier based Incentive Program for Sellers). You will join a high performing, learning\-oriented, analytical team who are motivated to work hard, have fun, and make history.  

As a program manager, you will be owning relationships with our selling partners and resolve their issues to better seller experience. You will be responsible for working closely with sellers, liaison with internal Product \& Program teams, SPS and account management teams to identify improvement areas and solve for the same to improve the seller experience on the Amazon platform.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Own and manage program delivery from concept through launch, defining goals, setting milestones, tracking progress, and proactively mitigating risks to keep scope and timelines on track.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams and stakeholders to align on priorities, secure resources, and drive crisp decisions that accelerate program outcomes.
* Identify key performance indicators and success metrics for your programs, using data to evaluate progress, surface trade\-offs, and recommend improvements that benefit the customer experience and business results.
* Communicate program status, risks, and strategic recommendations clearly to audiences ranging from working teams to senior leadership, building alignment and resolving conflicting viewpoints.
* Apply process improvement methodologies to simplify workflows, remove unnecessary complexity, and increase the productivity of the teams you collaborate with.
* Perform market studies through primary and secondary research to gather insights, collaborating with product teams to drive improvements.
* Develop dashboards and statistical models to streamline operations and increase team efficiency.

  

About the team  

STEP is a seller tiering program that influences, guides and rewards sellers to improve customer inputs. It does so by creating a framework to tier seller basis their performance against pre\-defined evaluation metrics and rewarding them differentially. Over the last two years, STEP program has driven improvements across key business metrics, such as Cancellation Rate and Late Dispatch Rate that it sought to influence. Voice of Seller (VOS) has been positive and also indicates that sellers leverage STEP to monitor their performance and improve customer experience.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

The Project Manager is responsible for delivering strategic projects across the AEM region within agreed scope, timeline, cost, quality, and risk parameters. This role applies disciplined project management practices to support growth initiatives, including go\-to\-market product launches, business transformation, business reengineering, and M\&A integrations.Working across multiple functions, geographies, and teams, the Project Manager will lead project planning, governance, financial and risk management, stakeholder engagement, and change control. The role will partner closely with Product Management, Technology, Segment leadership, Product Marketing, Finance, and other stakeholders to execute regional product roadmaps and business priorities.The successful candidate will be an adaptable, collaborative leader who can manage competing priorities, resolve conflicts, communicate effectively with a broad range of audiences, and promote agile ways of working, innovation, simplification, and appropriate use of AI within project delivery frameworks.Key propositions supported may include **CoCounsel, Westlaw, OneSource, and Checkpoint** .  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of projects across AEM portfolios, ensuring delivery within agreed scope, budget, schedule, quality, and resource constraints.
* Define, document, maintain, and execute project plans, milestones, dependencies, governance routines, and operating rhythms.
* Participate actively in all project phases, including initiation, planning, execution, monitoring, implementation, and closure.
* Adapt project management methodologies and approaches to meet the needs of a wide range of initiatives, including product launches, business transformation, technology, and reengineering projects.
* Manage project change control processes and secure stakeholder agreement for changes to scope, timelines, budget, or deliverables.
* Monitor project progress, costs, timescales, resources, and deliverables; take timely corrective action when performance deviates from agreed tolerances.
* Develop estimates for project costs, timelines, resource requirements, and delivery plans.
* Manage project financials and ensure projects are delivered within approved budgets.
* Identify, assess, document, and manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Escalate significant risks related to timeline, budget, scope, or delivery to project sponsors and the PMO as appropriate.
* Support Segment leads and Finance in the development of business cases for investments that enable new or enhanced propositions and regional growth.
* Build collaborative, trusted relationships with project sponsors, senior stakeholders, project team members, and cross\-functional partners.
* Work closely with Product Management, Technology, Segment teams, Product Marketing, Finance, and other functions to deliver product roadmaps and strategic initiatives.
* Lead cross\-functional project teams, creating clarity of purpose, accountability, and commitment to agreed outcomes.
* Proactively manage project team conflicts and facilitate constructive, win\-win resolutions.
* Motivate and support project team members, helping develop their project delivery skills and experience.
* Escalate unresolved issues, conflicts, or resource constraints through appropriate sponsorship and governance channels.
* Develop and implement effective project communication plans tailored to a diverse range of stakeholder audiences.
* Provide regular, accurate, and timely project reporting on status, milestones, risks, financials, decisions, and required actions.
* Clearly communicate project objectives, priorities, trade\-offs, and outcomes to stakeholders across regional and global teams.
* Foster an inclusive, values\-led culture that promotes strong collaboration across countries, regions, functions, and working styles.
* Support AEM growth priorities through strong project management execution for acquisitions, new product launches, product localization, and business transformation initiatives.
* Ensure project decisions and prioritization remain focused on customer and market value while balancing delivery commitments.
* Support the regional introduction and localization of global value propositions and products.
* Champion innovation, simplification, agile mindsets, and the effective use of AI within project delivery practices.
Build and maintain highly collaborative and mutually supportive relationships across AEM and the broader Thomson Reuters organization.  
* 

  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

  

* Demonstrated experience managing projects from initiation through implementation, including planning, execution, monitoring, risk management, financial management, and stakeholder reporting.
* Experience delivering projects across multiple teams, functions, geographies, or business priorities.
* Proven ability to manage project scope, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and change control.
* Experience with projects such as go\-to\-market product launches, business transformation, business reengineering, technology initiatives, or comparable complex business projects.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with senior sponsors and cross\-functional partners, including Product, Technology, Segment, Finance, and Marketing teams.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to tailor messages, reporting, and engagement approaches for different audiences.
* Demonstrated conflict\-resolution and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to drive alignment and achieve constructive outcomes.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
* Strong commercial awareness and experience estimating project costs, timelines, and resource requirements.
Commitment to inclusive collaboration, customer and market focus, disciplined execution, and continuous improvement.  
* 

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

  

* 5\+ years of experience in supporting regional or global product launches and adapting global product value propositions for local market needs.
* Experience working across the Asia \& Emerging Markets region, including ANZ, Asia, Middle East, Africa, and/or Russia.
* Experience supporting M\&A integrations, acquisitions, or large\-scale business transformation programs.
* Experience working in information services, technology, professional services, legal, tax, regulatory, or enterprise software environments.
* Familiarity with products or propositions such as CoCounsel, Westlaw, OneSource, Checkpoint, or similar digital and professional information solutions.
* Experience applying agile, hybrid, or adaptive project management approaches.
* Experience embedding AI\-enabled tools, innovation practices, or process simplification into project delivery.
Formal project management certification or training, such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or equivalent.  
* 

  

  

\#LI\-AD1

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.

**About the role:**



Join our dynamic team as an **Integrated Project Manager (Account Manager)**, where you'll have the opportunity to drive creative adaptation media production for a leading fashion brand in Kuala Lumpur \- Malaysia. Working from one of our regional satellite studios, you'll be instrumental in delivering projects for numerous markets in region. Reporting to the Regional Producer, you'll collaborate closely with regional teams, fostering strong relationships with key stakeholders driving impactful content production.



The **Integrated Project Manager (Account Manager)** understands the complexities of global brand campaign production cycles and has a comprehensive knowledge of universal print and moving image terminology. As a pivotal member of our team, you will assess upcoming campaign volumes and scope, reviewing SLA timings plans created by the Regional Producer, adapting where necessary to meet the nuanced lead times of the markets in your region to meet key milestones.



You will review global and local pipeline activations across print and moving image channels and assessing resource requirements ahead of time, ensuring campaigns are briefed to the creative team in a timely and accurate manner, identifying production overlaps and relaying regular status updates the Regional Producer.



As **Integrated Project Manager (Account Manager),** you will motivate your direct team to excel in their roles and ensure effective communication across regional teams, aligning on overarching objectives. The Integrated Project manager oversees the end\-to\-end production, actively tracking key milestones such as translation requests, in market price validation, client approvals and delivery, ensuring creative teams are working efficiently, managing status, risks and challenges of all the campaign deliverables and resource, escalating production issues to the Regional Producer. title: Technical Program Manager III, Seller Fulfillment Technology (International FBA Team)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Drive programs that power seller success across 10\+ global marketplaces — own S\-Team\-level Inventory \& MCF (Multi\-Channel Fulfilment) initiatives that leverage Generative AI to transform the seller experience and accelerate engineering delivery in one of Amazon's fastest\-growing international fulfilment ecosystems. As an Sr. Technical Program Manager, you will sit at the intersection of AI\-powered seller experiences and engineering efficiency — leading programs that use AI to simplify complex inventory workflows for millions of sellers while championing AI\-native development practices that multiply your team's delivery velocity. What you'll own: End\-to\-end delivery of S\-Team programs for the Inventory \& MCF Roadmap — including AI\-driven seller\-facing features such as intelligent inventory recommendations, AI\-assisted shipment creation, and automated restock guidance Programs that integrate Gen AI into seller touchpoints — WhatsApp\-based order tracking, AI\-powered inbound appointment experiences, and smart fulfilment recommendations across marketplaces Technical efficiency through AI adoption — driving AI\-native SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) practices including AI\-assisted code reviews, automated documentation, LLM\-powered scoping and estimation, and AI coding assistants to accelerate feature delivery Quarterly roadmap prioritization using data\-driven frameworks, balancing AI innovation with operational excellence Cross\-org coordination across engineering, product, and operations — resolving dependencies across 5\+ teams and multiple marketplaces Risk identification and mitigation leveraging AI\-assisted pattern detection and automated status reporting mechanisms Weekly program reporting and monthly cadence reviews with VP/Director\-level leadership Why you'll love it: Shape how AI transforms the seller experience at Amazon\-scale High\-visibility S\-Team programs with greenfield AI/ML opportunities Pioneer AI\-native ways of working that redefine TPM productivity Autonomy, ownership, and direct impact on millions of sellers globally  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Drive programs that power seller success across 10\+ global marketplaces — own S\-Team\-level Inventory \& MCF (Multi\-Channel Fulfilment) initiatives end\-to\-end in one of Amazon's fastest\-growing international fulfilment ecosystems. Leverage AI and automation to accelerate delivery, sharpen decision\-making, and redefine how technical program management operates at scale. Own end\-to\-end delivery of S\-Team programs and cross\-org initiatives for the Inventory and MCF Roadmap — from scoping and design through launch and post\-launch validation Drive quarterly roadmap review and prioritization using structured, data\-driven frameworks with a holistic annual planning perspective Coordinate across engineering, product, and operations teams to manage dependencies, resolve blockers, and ensure delivery alignment across IES (International Emerging and Established Stores) marketplaces Publish weekly program status reports, run monthly cadence reviews, and maintain transparent communication channels with VP/Director\-level leadership Proactively identify technical and delivery risks; develop mitigation strategies and escalation paths to protect timelines Contribute to technical strategy including architecture input, Tech Goals planning, and execution tracking frameworks Leverage AI tools and Generative AI to accelerate program management workflows — including automated status reporting, AI\-assisted risk identification, intelligent dependency tracking, and using AI coding assistants to prototype solutions and validate technical feasibility Champion AI\-native SDLC (Software Development Lifecycle) adoption within the team — driving experiments with AI\-powered code reviews, automated documentation generation, and LLM\-assisted scoping and estimation Build mechanisms for operational excellence — standardize program execution, reduce manual toil through automation, and create scalable frameworks that the broader org can adopt Influence without authority across multiple teams and orgs; mentor junior TPMs and contribute to team culture and hiring bar  

  

A day in the life  

Our primary focus is making sure complex, multi\-team programs land on time — and that the right people have the right information to make decisions fast. You'll kick off most mornings scanning AI\-generated program dashboards to spot what's off\-track. You're not waiting for someone to escalate — you're the one who catches a slipping timeline before it becomes a fire. Mid\-morning, you're running syncs with engineers and product managers across multiple teams — unblocking dependencies, aligning priorities, and making sure everyone's rowing in the same direction. These aren't status meetings; they're working sessions where decisions happen. Afternoons look different every day: One day you're leading a roadmap prioritization session — making the case for which AI\-powered seller features ship next versus which platform investments need to come first Another day you're scoping a new Gen AI feature that will simplify how sellers manage their inventory across multiple countries — writing the brief, stress\-testing the timeline, and lining up the engineering teams Sometimes you're deep in a technical design review with engineers — you don't write the code, but you understand the architecture well enough to ask the hard questions and flag risks early You might also be preparing a crisp leadership update for a VP audience — distilling weeks of complexity into a one\-page narrative that drives a decision Beyond the day\-to\-day, you'll also champion new ways of working — experimenting with AI tools to automate status reporting, speed up estimation, and reduce the manual grind that slows teams down. You'll help the broader org adopt these practices too. Who you'll work with: Engineers, product managers, operations leaders, and senior leadership — across multiple countries and time zones. Who you're building for: Millions of sellers who rely on seamless inventory and fulfilment systems to run their businesses across global marketplaces. What problems you'll solve: How to deliver ambitious programs faster with fewer handoffs, how to use AI to simplify seller workflows that are currently painful, and how to build repeatable playbooks that scale beyond your own portfolio.  

  

About the team  

We build AI\-powered inventory and multi\-channel fulfilment systems that serve millions of sellers across international marketplaces. Our technology handles the complexity of warehousing, shipping, and stock management — so sellers can focus on growing their business. We're using Generative AI on two fronts: building intelligent seller experiences (smart restock recommendations, AI\-assisted shipment creation, real\-time tracking) and accelerating how we develop software (AI coding assistants, automated documentation, LLM\-powered estimation). You'll work alongside engineers, product managers, and operations teams across multiple countries — with startup\-level autonomy and direct senior leadership access.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* 5\+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
