Recognised as World Economic Forum’s Global Innovator 2025, CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies (2025, 2024\), and LinkedIn’s Top Startup (2024, 2023\), YouTrip is dedicated to creating the next generation of digital finance services for consumers and businesses.


Valuing an entrepreneurial culture of diversity and inclusion, we are seeking driven individuals to join our fast\-growing regional team as we push the boundaries of innovative fintech solutions.


Job Description: Technical Program Manager

  

As a Technical Program Manager at YouTrip, you'll help our engineering organization deliver complex, cross\-team programs that power payments for millions of customers and businesses across Asia Pacific. You'll bring structure to large initiatives that span mobile, backend, infrastructure, risk, and compliance. You'll turn ambiguous goals into clear roadmaps, keep teams across India and the region aligned, and make sure critical launches ship on time, safely, and at the quality our customers expect from a financial product.

  

You'll also help raise the bar for how engineering works at YouTrip by driving shared standards, better delivery processes, and the tools and practices that help teams move faster with confidence. This role needs a strong mix of technical understanding and people skills, so you can earn the trust of engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders alike.

  

Technical Program Management at YouTrip sits within our engineering organization and plays a key role in helping teams across India and the region deliver as one. TPMs are experienced technologists who create clarity, make sure we focus on the right priorities, drive execution, and manage risk on programs that depend on strong cross\-team collaboration. You'll be joining a growing India team at an important stage, with real influence over how we build and scale.


Responsibilities:

* Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of multiple complex, technical programs at once, such as new market launches, card and payment network integrations, platform migrations, and regulatory or security initiatives.
* Work with engineering, product, design, QA, risk, compliance, and operations teams to define scope, requirements, milestones, and ownership.
* Build roadmaps that balance near\-term deliverables with the longer\-term technical direction of each program.
* Track progress, surface blockers early, and resolve cross\-team dependencies across India and regional teams in Singapore and other markets.
* Anticipate risks across teams and systems, and put mitigation and contingency plans in place before they affect customers or deadlines.
* Use metrics throughout the program lifecycle (delivery health, quality, reliability, and business outcomes) so decisions are grounded in data.
* Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels, from engineering teams to senior leadership, through status updates, reviews, and presentations.
* Coordinate release planning for mobile (Android and iOS) and backend services, including launch readiness, rollouts, and post\-launch reviews.
* Drive improvements to engineering processes, such as planning cadences, incident follow\-ups, documentation standards, and delivery tooling.
* Help teams work well together by building a collaborative, accountable, and enjoyable program culture.

  

**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8\+ years of experience in technology, including at least 4 years as a Technical Program Manager, engineering manager, or in a similar delivery leadership role.
* A background as a software engineer or in a closely related technical role, with the ability to follow system design discussions and spot edge cases and risks in technical specs.
* Working knowledge of several technology areas, such as mobile development, backend and distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, data, or security, and the ability to pick up new ones quickly.
* Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or other regulated environments is a strong plus.
* Proven success delivering large programs across multiple teams, time zones, and locations.
* Comfort with ambiguity and a habit of creating clarity: you make sure goals, owners, dependencies, and risks are understood by everyone involved.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics simply to technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Strong relationship\-building skills: you know how to align people with different priorities, make sure every voice is heard, and gain commitment to a shared plan.
* A focus on outcomes over activity: you prioritize by impact, think strategically, and are still willing to dig into details to help the team deliver.
* Familiarity with Agile and Scrum practices, OKRs, and tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, CSM, SAFe) are a plus but not required.

  

To Apply


If you're interested in this role, click Apply Now and send us your CV. Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.



Google’s Global Security and Resilience Services (GSRS) team is keeping Google employees safe and secure to manage disruptive incidents and crises, and to anticipate, deter, detect, and act.
  

  

In this role, you will help develop a culture where safety, security and resiliency are integrated into every facet of Google, including the creative process. title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**Who are we?**  

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.  

In this role, you will own and drive strategic technical programs assigned by the Engineering organization. Program assignments will shift over time based on where the business requires delivery leadership — you may lead a single large, multi\-quarter initiative or a portfolio of smaller related efforts. In all cases, the programs you own will be funded, executive\-sponsored initiatives that advance our technology strategy, architectural direction, and/or company strategic plan. You will be expected to ramp quickly on new domains, establish the operating cadence and reporting for the programs you inherit, and transition mature programs into a sustainable business\-as\-usual state.
### **How will you contribute?**


**How will you contribute?**


* Understands the system architecture within program domain. Knows how to make sure dependencies are not broken by development changes and that program systems are not broken by upstream changes.
* Able to consider the larger picture (e.g., efficiency, availability, operability, scalability, business goals, customer experience, etc.) and balance it against the needs of engineering teams who have to build, maintain and extend features for the life of the technology. Incorporates these requirements into project plans.
* See's patterns and discovers solutions; makes connections to improve project/process efficiency. Knows what solutions exist elsewhere and how they can be connected.
* Can convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering team(s) (Q. Why did we build X? What business goal does it solve?).
* Knows how to assess engineering practices for testing, triage and maintenance and work with manager(s) to establish the right methods for effective project delivery.
* Multi\-disciplinary organizational skills with strong people and conflict management abilities.
* Analytical, design, problem solving skills towards customer success.
* Communication and collaboration skills.
### **What will you bring?**


* As part of your project and program ownership, you know the larger business picture (i.e., customer experience, organization goals, opportunities, and/or problems) and you deeply understand the technical requirements of the solutions being built (i.e., architecture, dependency impacts, efficiency, performance, availability, operability, etc.).
* You also take the time to understand the needs of engineers (who have to build, maintain, and extend features for the life of the system) to make appropriate trade\-offs.
* You remove blockers and impediments that impact the team. Organize the team to provide productive, consistent and steady output.
* You partner effectively with technical managers to secure resources, scope engineering efforts, set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery.
* You provide status reporting to senior leadership and C\-staff on your program.
* You help teams determine where to iterate to make improvements.
* You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them.
* Bachelors/Masters or equivalent.
**About our culture**  

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
description:
**Company Description**  

At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future

 **Job Description** **Strategic Mandate**


As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**

* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking

  

**Qualifications** **Expertise \& Technology Stack**

* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking

  

**Additional Information** **Requirements \& Qualifications**

* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

The Software and Digital Platforms Group at ADI is seeking an accomplished Principal Project/Program Manager to lead the end\-to\-end development of complex, multi\-core SoCs and platform\-based products.


In this high\-impact role, you will drive requirements alignment, risk\-managed execution, and on\-time delivery across diverse cross\-functional teams spanning hardware, software, IP, system architecture, and foundry engineering. You will help define and deliver the next generation of integrated digital platforms that power ADI’s intelligent edge solutions.

  

**What You’ll Do**

* **Lead Complex SoC Development Programs**  

Drive product execution from concept through silicon delivery and production release — managing hardware, software, IP, and system integration across global teams.
* **Own Program Planning and Governance**  

Define and manage the Plan of Record (POR) including scope, schedule, cost, and risk. Apply structured change management through the Change Request (CR) process to maintain execution discipline and traceability.
* **Align Technical and Business Requirements**  

Partner with product, architecture, and engineering teams to translate system\-level requirements into actionable technical milestones and verification goals. Ensure alignment across HW/SW interfaces and third\-party IPs.
* **Ensure Predictable, On\-Time Execution**  

Develop detailed program schedules across multiple functional workstreams. Track dependencies, identify risks early, and drive timely mitigation to maintain schedule fidelity.
* **Drive Proactive Risk Management**  

Establish a culture of early risk identification, quantification, and mitigation. Lead structured risk reviews and implement data\-driven trade\-off decisions to keep projects on track.
* **Enable Cross\-Functional Collaboration**  

Foster strong collaboration between system, hardware, software, IP, and foundry teams to ensure seamless integration and efficient debug/validation closure.
* **Drive Process and Execution Excellence**  

Contribute to **continuous process improvements** across planning, execution, and communication workflows. Identify and implement enhancements that improve efficiency, predictability, and quality across programs.
* **Communicate with Clarity and Influence**  

Provide transparent, data\-backed program updates to engineering leadership and business stakeholders. Balance customer commitments with long\-term platform scalability.
* **Mentor and Lead by Example**  

Support the growth of ADI’s project management community through mentorship, coaching, and promoting best practices in program execution, stakeholder management, and continuous improvement.

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field (Master’s preferred).
* 15\+ years of experience leading complex SoC or ASIC programs with high system integration.
* Proven success managing multi\-core processors, HW/SW co\-development, and multi\-IP integration.
* Deep understanding of SoC design flows including architecture, RTL, verification, validation, and productization.
* Demonstrated excellence in requirements management, schedule control, and risk management.
* Experience working within a phase\-gate or hybrid product development lifecycle.
* Strong organizational, leadership, and communication skills; able to engage effectively across technical and executive levels.
* PMP certification or equivalent experience preferred.
* Experience collaborating with external IP vendors, foundries, and system\-level customers is highly desirable.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Who We Are**

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

* As a PM working in Human Capital Management or Advisory Services supporting HR Services/Payroll, Compensation, Benefits and or Talent and must be PMI certified within the last 3 years

* Ensures that the project plan delivers expected results and that milestones are clear and can be tracked, and delivered on time, on scope, on budget.

Key Responsibilities:


* Ensures alignment to the PMO governance process for all projects and change initiatives leveraging PMO tools and templates

Your Future at Kyndryl
  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. We have training and upskilling programs that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands\-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.  



  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer\-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.  



Required Skills:


* Past experience working in an HR PMO; Workday implementation
* At least three years of related experience required
* PMP, PgMP, CAPM, and/or comparable project management certifications required
* Strong project management acumen, with excellent grasp of program management methodologies including project risk management
* Excellent analytical, organizational and problem\-solving skills, as well as a demonstrated ability to simultaneously control numerous projects
* Capacity to anticipate, comprehend and manage project dependencies across other initiatives in the organization
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, report preparation and research skills
* Excellent organizational skills and time management skills with attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines
* Well\-developed consultative approach \- listening, coaching and influencing skills
* Ability to build relationships with colleagues across business lines and levels utilizing exceptional listening and facilitation skills to drive effective outcomes and to develop innovative solutions that meet the needs of multiple stakeholders
* Ability to manage independently, prioritize tasks and to delegate them when appropriate
* Thorough understanding of or the ability to quickly learn about the HR function and the significant projects, processes or practices being developed
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Project Management tools, including Microsoft Projects is required; understanding of databases and project management software is a must

Preferred Skills:


* Bachelor’s degree required with preference for related field, which may include Business Administration, Finance, Engineering or Technology

Other Requirements:


* Must be open to working flexible hours as a part of a global team
* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

You oversee hardware lifecycle initiatives, monitor component availability risks, manage product change activities, and drive execution of hardware projects from concept through deployment and sustainment.
Your mission is to proactively identify and mitigate product availability risks, coordinate hardware lifecycle activities, and ensure successful execution of hardware programs without disrupting customer commitments. Job Description \- Construction Manager (PDS)
  
  

Construction Manager
  
Project and Development Services – Corporate Solutions (region/country)
  
  

**What this job involves:**  

Being the backbone of construction projects
  
You’ll oversee all day\-to\-day construction\-related projects onsite and make sure that all budget, risk, schedule, design, safety and quality management requirements are met. As the go\-to person in all construction activities, you’ll help fix any issues that may arise—all while taking heed of clients’ expectations and the company’s procedures. Your task is to ensure all site contractors involved in the project are working on all counts and with telling effect. As needed, you will also cooperate with LDI and the client to monitor, review and resolve any site\-related issues. Using the JLL Atlas platform, you’ll set up site procedures to ensure the program, cost, design, safety and quality are aligned. You’ll also be responsible for holding internal and external construction meetings.
  
Planning successful outcomes
  
As a construction manager, a thoughtful deliverable strategy is your weapon. You’ll need to prepare a master construction schedule for site as well as client and tracking. Part of regular checklist is to review all pending issues with the site team to steer clear of any communication gaps and develop action plans as soon as possible. You’ll also conduct weekly site and report meetings with consultants, contractors and agencies to review the progress per agreed schedule and proactively follow up on all pending issues. Likewise, you’ll review the site’s progress payments to make sure claims from subcontractors reflect the actual progress.
  
Mastering technical management and communication
  
In this role, you’ll take the lead and track the progress of coordination drawings submitted by local design consultants, and to get a hold of and follow up drawings, details or clarifications, as needed. You’ll then need to review these drawings to make sure they’re foolproof. You’ll also manage the technical handover and the client’s sign off at the end of a project. Equally, you’ll review the work method statement from subcontractors. On top of these, you’ll also review VOs and make sure they’re valid; set up the site diary and record system; and other duties, as directed.
  
Clearing safety and quality hurdles
  
This role calls for a champion for safety and quality management. Part of your responsibilities is to review the RFP documentation from a constructability point of view, provide the work scope; make sure that you go over safe work method statements by Janli; hold safety meetings on a weekly basis; take care of monthly health and safety reports; and make sure that the construction works match the client’s expectations.
  
  

**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**  

Seasoned and credentialed
  
You have a degree in architectural, civil engineering, MEP engineering, or related discipline or field, or a mix of formal education and work experience of more than five years. Experience in construction site management is a must. You should also have completed safety trainings and must have acquired construction estimation skills.
  
Highly technical and administrative
  
A strong understanding of all aspects of development management—including financial, appraisal, risk management, and negotiation, among others—is required for this role. Do you consider yourself a pro at planning projects, procedures and construction schedules? How familiar are you with MS Project, MS Excel and other scheduling software? You should also have the know\-how of interpreting, coordinating and discussing construction drawings. As construction manager, design contracts and commercial negotiations should already be second nature to you. Also indispensable in this role is your ability to sit in on market analyses and marketing processes.
  
An excellent communicator
  
To excel in this role, you should have a superb communication skills, which will be helpful to you in winning businesses with both international and domestic clients. Your great communication skills will also serve as a tool in inspiring your members and contractors; keeping healthy client relationships alive; making headways in promoting a culture of openness; and bringing on project success stories.
  
  

**What we can do for you:**

Job Description \- Compliance Lead (PDS)

Communication skills ensure that the compliance officer can successfully communicate their findings, ideas and plans to both management and employees.

Problem\-solving skills are necessary because many compliance issues have no straightforward solution and compliance officers need to find ways of complying with rules and regulations without negatively affecting the company’s operations.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Technical Project Manager to join the Value\-Added Services PMO, leading delivery within the Customer Journey portfolio. This role is responsible for driving complex enterprise application initiatives across platforms including Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), Configure Price Quote (CPQ), Lead Management, customer engagement solutions, AI\-powered automation, integrations, data platforms, analytics, and sales technologies.


The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of technical expertise, project delivery leadership, enterprise systems knowledge, and stakeholder management skills. This individual will partner closely with product, engineering, architecture, data, security, and operations teams to deliver scalable technology solutions that improve customer experiences, business processes, and operational effectiveness.


Success in this role requires experience managing complex technology projects spanning enterprise applications, APIs, integrations, data platforms, cloud technologies, AI\-enabled solutions, and Agile software delivery teams within a global, matrixed environment.


Essential Functions:


Technical Project Leadership:

* Lead the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of complex technology projects supporting the Customer Journey portfolio.
* Manage cross\-functional initiatives spanning enterprise applications, integrations, data platforms, automation solutions, AI capabilities, and customer\-facing technologies.
* Drive end\-to\-end technology delivery from concept and architecture through development, testing, deployment, adoption, and operational transition.


Enterprise Applications \& Technology Delivery:

* Lead projects supporting Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM, CLM, CPQ, Lead Management, sales operations, customer engagement platforms, and related business applications.
* Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define technical roadmaps, solution strategies, system dependencies, and implementation approaches.
* Oversee delivery across multiple technology workstreams including application development, integrations, APIs, data migration, reporting, automation, and infrastructure readiness.
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security controls, privacy requirements, and data governance policies.


AI, Automation \& Innovation:

* Lead implementation of AI\-enabled capabilities, Copilot solutions, agentic workflows, automation platforms, and intelligent business process technologies.
* Identify opportunities to leverage emerging technologies to improve delivery efficiency, customer insights, productivity, and operational performance.
* Partner with technology teams to evaluate technical feasibility, integration requirements, scalability, and adoption strategies.


Project Governance \& Delivery Management:

* Define and manage scope, schedules, releases, milestones, budgets, resource plans, dependencies, risks, issues, and delivery outcomes.
* Establish project governance frameworks, executive reporting, delivery metrics, and implementation readiness plans.
* Coordinate complex cross\-team releases while ensuring quality, supportability, operational readiness, and business continuity.


Stakeholder \& Technical Leadership:

* Collaborate with product owners, software engineers, architects, data teams, security teams, operations teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Lead executive\-level communications, technical decision forums, stakeholder alignment sessions, and delivery reviews.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor's degree, OR 2\+ years of relevant work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g., Master's, MBA, JD, MD), OR 0 years of experience with a PhD.


Preferred Qualifications:


Technical Experience:

* 6\+ years of experience delivering complex enterprise applications, digital transformation, or technology modernization projects.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience considered.
* Understanding of enterprise application architecture, cloud technologies, system integrations, APIs, event\-driven architectures, and data platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM or comparable CRM platforms supporting sales, customer service, or customer engagement functions.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, Power Automate, Dataverse, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Power BI, SharePoint, Jira, Confluence, Teams, or similar enterprise technology ecosystems.
* Experience delivering projects involving APIs, middleware, data migration, master data management, reporting platforms, workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, release management, testing strategies, QA coordination, environment management, and production support transitions.
* Familiarity with AI technologies, Copilot solutions, agentic systems, machine learning\-enabled workflows, and intelligent automation platforms.


Project \& Leadership Experience:

* Proven ability to lead large\-scale, cross\-functional technology projects involving engineering, architecture, product, security, and business teams.
* Experience managing technology budgets, vendor relationships, resource planning, risk mitigation, and executive governance processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to make data\-driven decisions in complex technical environments.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into executive\-ready business messaging.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels and drive alignment across competing priorities.
* Demonstrated success delivering results within fast\-paced, global, matrixed organizations.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**


Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
Overview:
**Working at Atlassian**


Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.


Responsibilities:

The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI\-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost\-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low\-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self\-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI\-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise\-grade decision\-making.


As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.

**What you'll do**

* Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long\-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
* Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.
* Define specific systems programs and create a plan of action for realizing those programs. Such programs could be around capacity planning, migration efforts, high availability, network architecture, performance optimization, reliability improvements and more.
* Use your technical understanding of Atlassian and related systems to partner with and influence engineers and architects in making progress on these problems.
* Responsible for taking a systematic approach to engineering problems. This includes: prioritizing tasks, scoping out the project, defining objectives, and making consistent progress against each of these.
* Be accountable for the success of these technical programs by managing the entire lifecycle from initiation to forecasting, budgeting, scheduling, etc.
* Manage complex dependencies and projects with a broad scope across the company


Compensation:

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.


This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.


Qualifications:
* 8\+ years of experience on software teams as Development Manager or TPM
* Strategic thinking and ability to understand business objectives to translate them into technical problems and programs.
* Technical understanding of systems involved. Willingness to develop domain expertise in the area they operate \- storage, networking, authentication, capacity management, service deployments, etc.


	+ TPMs are not expected to write or read code, but are expected to understand system flows, block architectures, APIs and such.
* Experience defining and running end\-to\-end complex technical programs
* Strong leadership, organizational, and communication skills

**Benefits \& Perks**


Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit **go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits****.**

**About Atlassian**


At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.


We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.


To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.


To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit **go.atlassian.com/crh****.**


In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

title: Staff Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Leasing & Capitalization
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================


As a Staff Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Leasing \& Capitalization, you will execute within the established strategy and operating model for Asset Lease Management, overseeing the lease lifecycle from contract and negotiation through renewal, buyout, and asset retirement. This role partners closely with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology stakeholders to structure and manage lease agreements that optimize financial, operational, and business outcomes while ensuring compliance with accounting and governance requirements.  

You will support the financial and operational management of the infrastructure lease portfolio, including forecasting, budgeting, payment administration, asset capitalization (as needed), and lease performance reporting. As the Staff Technical Program Manager of lease and asset data integrity, you will ensure accurate contract, financial, and asset records within enterprise systems of record. This role provides expertise in finance and operating lease evaluations, supports vendor negotiations and buyout strategies, and delivers insights that maximize asset value, control costs, and support long\-term technology investment decisions across GE HealthCare.**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Executes projects within the established Asset and Lease Management strategy and operating model, managing the roadmap, and governance framework to support long\-term technology lifecycle and financial management objectives.
* Accountable to deliver the long\-term Asset and Lease framework, including new leases, lease buyout, optimization opportunities, TSA strategy, and billing and data integrity
* Partner with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, vendors, and technology teams to support the negotiation of lease agreements, financial terms, and buyout strategies that align with business and accounting requirements.
* Collaborate with business partners and technology leadership to support the execution infrastructure needs including tracking the progress, key milestones, asset health, and interdependencies.
* Support the vendor strategy and contract agreements in partnership with sourcing and VMO teams to complete project activities
* Track the budget, including forecasting, actuals updates, and variance reviews on a monthly basis
* Participates in Operating Mechanisms with partners to receive consolidated updates and discuss risks and strategies to ensure outcomes are delivered
* Prepare stakeholder communication and progress reporting at various levels of the organization including leadership and executives
* Ensure quality of deliverables is verified and matching stakeholder expectations
* Track outcomes realization and customer satisfaction levels through established metrics against service level. Ensure lessons learned are collected
* Perform financial reviews and approval processes for new leases, amendments, buyouts, capitalization events, and asset transitions.
* Maintain the enterprise system of record for leased assets, ensuring accuracy of contract details, asset records, serializations, financial attributes, ownership information, and lifecycle events.
* Ensure data integrity, audit readiness, compliance, and accurate financial reporting across all leased assets and agreements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Information Systems, Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, or Engineering or 4 years of IT technical experience
* Minimum 8 years of IT professional experience
* Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Asset and Lease Management including project and financial management leading cross functional initiatives and/or large global projects

**Desired Characteristics**

* Proven expertise in enterprise Asset and Lease Management, including lease structuring, contract administration, buyouts, asset lifecycle management, and financial governance specific to Infrastructure Hosting and Network portfolio.
* Strong understanding of finance lease and operating lease models, capitalization policies, depreciation methodologies, and accounting implications.
* Experience partnering with Treasury, Finance, Sourcing, Legal, and vendors to support complex lease agreements and financial commitments.
* Demonstrated success managing large infrastructure asset portfolios, including hosting, network, data center, and end\-user technology assets.
* Strong financial acumen with experience in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, payment management, and lease portfolio optimization.
* Expertise in maintaining accurate asset and lease records, ensuring data integrity across systems of record, financial platforms, and reporting tools.
* Knowledge of global financial, tax, regulatory, and compliance considerations related to leased technology assets.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess financial impacts, identify optimization opportunities, and drive informed business decisions.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and lead cross\-functional initiatives across Finance, Treasury, Sourcing, Vendor Management, and Technology organizations.
* Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex financial and contractual concepts into actionable business insights.
* Experience supporting vendor negotiations, lease renewals, restructures, buyouts, and asset disposition strategies to optimize financial and operational outcomes.
* Experience working within global organizations and coordinating activities across multiple regions, business units, and stakeholders.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a track record of driving process standardization, automation, governance maturity, and operational excellence.

**Additional Information**
==========================

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

title: Program Manager I, FBA
description:

---------------


Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is a service for third\-party sellers that enables fast and efficient delivery to customers. FBA allows sellers to outsource warehousing, payment processing, delivery returns, and customer service to Amazon. This frees sellers to focus on product development and marketing their products to potential customers.
  

  

We're seeking a dynamic Program Manager to drive transformative improvements in fulfillment experience of India FBA sellers. In this high\-impact role you will spearhead initiatives to reduce seller contacts and eliminate friction for IN sellers.  

  

The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker with:  

* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated program or project management capabilities
* An ability to influence stakeholders at all levels
* A talent for quickly identifying and addressing customer pain points
* Strong relationship\-building and communication skills

  

Key job responsibilities  

1\. Design, standardize and implement innovative processes across multiple business functions  

2\. Performs quantitative analysis of key process indicators to identify opportunities and deploy tactical initiatives  

3\. Work with product or tech teams to scope out and drive tech changes
  

4\. Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including account managers, product managers, and finance partners to drive program goals  

5\. Drive business profitability through end to end ownership of the program**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience effectively communicating complex concepts through written and verbal communication
* Knowledge of SQL and Excel at a moderate or advanced level

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of Lean principles and DMAIC methodology
